player_prompt.intro:
Nim gi Player {player_id} ni.
Touning last object alungba ngaijare.
Turn ama, pile ok oiba, ama object ok alungba.
Format '[pile quantity]' bu use toiba, pile index le quantity alungbana.
Example: '[0 3]' pile 0 gi 3 object alungbana.

invalid_move.wrong_format: চৎনবা য়াবা খোঙথাং ফোর্মেত অমত্তা ফংদ্রে. '[pile quantity]' শিজিন্নৌ.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Thouram asidi. Column {col} khongjang louba.
invalid_move.out_of_range: পাইল ইন্দেক্স {pile_index} অসি রেঞ্জগী মপান্দা লৈ।
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: {quantity} khut taanba pile {pile_index} taanba matang ahallu ( {pile_count} pou ollommi).

observation.removed_from_piles: Khelgi {player_id} [{pile_index} {quantity}] khelgi, {quantity} leirang (leirang) pile {pile_index} gi koida thokpa.
